newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm ahead of Eurobond rating.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm ahead of Eurobond rating.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose in lively trading on Thursday, tracking the upward trend of Vnesh debt, and dealers said the market was looking up ahead of the announcement of the rating for Russia's Eurobonds.
The Eurobond issue is planned for launch by the end of September or early October. Finance ministry officials have said the rating will be published by the end of September.
"All prices rose some 3/8 in early trading and went up further when London operators stepped in. The main reason is the forthcoming Eurobond rating," one dealer said.
He added prices had also caught up with Vnesh debt prices which rose late on Wednesday.
Another Russian bank dealer said buying was mainly seen from abroad. Some Russian banks were buying but others were selling.
Dealers forecast prices were likely to rise further as there were no negative factors to stop the rise.
